review.recommended_value: Một thành phần xử lý ảnh cần thiết không khả dụng. Không nhập được ảnh.
review.notes: Revise the result clause to Không nhập được ảnh. Chưa được nhập literally carries a not-yet-imported aspect, which can suggest a pending state; the replacement directly states failure to import in this error context. The first clause correctly describes a necessary image-processing component as unavailable. The recommended full sentence remains subject to fluent Vietnamese review. Both clauses were reviewed. The recommendation names no specific converter, service provider, outage, or recovery action. Independent model-based assessment, not native-speaker certification. Existing colour_converter_unavailable values are outside the edit scope and must remain unchanged.

original_judgment.final: Một thành phần xử lý ảnh cần thiết không khả dụng. Không nhập được ảnh.

correction_cross_review.recommended_value: Một thành phần xử lý ảnh cần thiết không khả dụng. Không nhập được ảnh.
correction_cross_review.notes: Accept the recommended revision. Một thành phần xử lý ảnh cần thiết names a required image-processing component and không khả dụng states unavailability. Không nhập được ảnh is a natural error-result construction meaning that the image could not be imported. In this failed-import context it preserves the source outcome and avoids the original chưa được nhập wording’s possible not-yet/pending implication. This is an inability/result construction rather than a literal English past passive; Vietnamese does not require English-style past-tense inflection. Both complete sentences were reviewed against the English source. Fluent-speaker review is still needed for native-level certification. The complete recommendation does not identify a colour converter, provider outage, document mutation, or recovery promise. Model-based cross-review; not human native-speaker certification. Existing colour_converter_unavailable values must remain unchanged.

qualification: Original revise is followed by explicit medium-confidence cross-review acceptance of the complete recommendation; fluent/native certification remains open.
